name: codex-pet-link
description: Broadcast Codex task titles and activity phases to a Rokid cyber pet over Bluetooth.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex task activity on a Rokid pet
interface.longDescription: Runs a local macOS BLE helper and forwards privacy-filtered Codex lifecycle events so a Rokid cyber pet can show the current task title and phase.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check Codex Pet Link and diagnose it if it is not running.
